summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is now live across grok.com, X, iOS, Android, and Microsoft 365 add-ins for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

mechanisms.reason: Rolling an existing model out to high-volume consumer surfaces like X, iOS, and Android widens the aggregate inference surface even though no usage figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.5 now powers Grok wherever you use it , live today on grok.com , on X, and in the Grok apps for iOS and Android.

practices.reason: New Microsoft 365 add-in surfaces mean teams embedding Grok into office workflows would use a different integration path than the API alone.
practices.quote: Grok also works directly inside Word , Excel , PowerPoint , and Outlook with our Microsoft 365 add-ins.
